notes: Texts read from sheet 176 of the tournament savegame (card images) on 2026-11-22; the seven MISERIES are sheet 177 (Woe, Toil, Pain, Misfortune, Hope, Greed, Confusion). Ivan 2026-11-22 (PA1): the Kakodaemons enter the board only through the Miseries (Woe).

Pandora's Box is the trigger `pandora_box`: the plugin `pandora:reveal` (the decision to keep revealing, then the next Misery: drawn at random among the unrevealed when it is revealed, so there is no order to peek at; the human's physical Box is ASKED instead), the effect of that Misery, and `pandora:close` (three feathers: stop and 1 damage per revealed Misery; otherwise rewind). The ability counters hold the revealed ones as a bit mask; the trigger `pandora_shuffle` empties them at the end of her turn, so on the rival's turn the revealed count is 0.

ability.text:
PANDORA'S BOX
Do not start with any Kakodaemons on the board.
At the start of your turn, open Pandora's Box.

The rulebook: Pandora's Box is a deck of seven cards called MISERIES. When you open it, reveal the top card and resolve its effect if any. You may keep revealing and resolving additional cards, one at a time, until you choose to stop. If there are three or more total feathers on revealed cards, you must stop revealing, then Pandora takes 1 damage for each revealed MISERY. At the end of your turn, shuffle all revealed MISERIES back into Pandora's Box.

triggers.notes: WOE: a defeated Kakodaemon returns with 1 health, else one comes out of the reserve, in Pandora's zone (Ivan 2026-11-22: the only way they enter). TOIL: +1 to Pandora's attacks until the end of the turn. PAIN: 1 damage to each opposing fighter adjacent to Pandora. MISFORTUNE: two feathers, no effect. HOPE: look at the top card (plugin `pandora:look`). GREED: draw 1. CONFUSION: move Pandora up to 1 space. The first reveal is mandatory.
All revealed MISERIES go back into the Box at the end of her turn.

ability.notes: The hero card prints only the first two lines; the rest is the rulebook's (the brief of batch 4). unmatched-memory spells Kakodamons and has a missing parenthesis: the real card is used.

cards.title: Hera's Curiosity
cards.text: DURING COMBAT: Add +1 to this card's value for each revealed MISERY. AFTER COMBAT: Look at your opponent's hand.
cards.notes: Attack 3 / boost 4, Pandora only. Counts the MISERIES revealed this turn (counter `revealed`, 0 on the rival's turn). The look is the card's own AFTER (hidden information: the bot reads the human's hand only then).

cards.title: Hindsight
cards.text: AFTER COMBAT: If you won the combat, return a card from your discard pile to the top of your deck.
cards.notes: Attack 3 / boost 2, Pandora only. The owner chooses the card; with an empty discard pile nothing happens (the card played is not in the pile yet).

cards.title: Aphrodite's Beauty
cards.text: IMMEDIATELY: Cancel all effects on your opponent's card. AFTER COMBAT: Pandora recovers 1 health for each revealed MISERY.
cards.notes: Attack 0 / boost 3 as printed (unmatched-memory says 3 / 2), band ANY. The heal goes to Pandora, whoever played the card, and counts the MISERIES revealed when it resolves.

cards.title: Spite
cards.text: AFTER COMBAT: Deal 1 damage to each fighter adjacent to your fighter.
cards.notes: Attack 3 / boost 2, Kakodaemon only. Every fighter adjacent to the one that played it, friendly ones included.

cards.title: Divine Intervention
cards.text: AFTER COMBAT: Move Pandora up to 5 spaces.

cards.title: Feint
cards.text: IMMEDIATELY: Cancel all effects on your opponent's card.

cards.title: Guided by the Fates
cards.text: DURING COMBAT: Discard the top card of your deck. Add its BOOST value to this card's value. AFTER COMBAT: If you won the combat, Pandora recovers 2 health.
cards.notes: Versatile 2 / boost 3, band ANY. The top card goes to the discard pile first and its BOOST is added; with an empty deck it adds 0. The heal is Pandora's whoever played it.

cards.title: Malice
cards.text: AFTER COMBAT: Your opponent discards 1 card.
cards.notes: Versatile 2 / boost 2, Kakodaemon only. The rival chooses the card.

cards.title: Offering to the Gods
cards.text: DURING COMBAT: You may BOOST this card. AFTER COMBAT: If you won the combat, deal 2 damage to the opposing fighter.
cards.notes: Defense 2 / boost 1, Pandora only. `may_boost`: the free BOOST of the card (docs/effects-dsl.md section 1; the engine's convention for "You may BOOST this card").

cards.title: Celestial Raiments
cards.text: DURING COMBAT: Ignore the value of your opponent's card.
cards.notes: Defense 0 / boost 3, Pandora only. `set_value ignore`: the rival's total is 0 at that moment; a later BOOST or effect still adds (engine convention, REGLAS-PENDIENTES section 2).

cards.title: Zeus's Mischief
cards.text:
Draw 1 card for each revealed MISERY.
Move an opposing fighter up to 1 space.
Gain 1 action.
cards.notes: Scheme, boost 1, Pandora only. Counts the MISERIES revealed this turn; the owner chooses the opposing fighter and where it goes.

cards.title: Forged by Hephaestus
cards.text:
Place your fighter in any space.
Gain 1 action.
cards.notes: Scheme, boost 1, band ANY: the fighter that plays it is placed.

plugins.why: One pass of the Box: the decision to keep revealing and the next Misery (random among the unrevealed, asked of the table player who holds the real cards).
HOPE: fixes the top card of the Box for the owner who looks at it before deciding.
Three feathers: stop and 1 damage per revealed Misery; otherwise rewinds the run to its first op (the DSL has no loop).

hidden_info.what: looks at the top card of her own Box
hidden_info.bot_rule: The bot may know its own Box's top card (own information); the human looks at the real card. The bot never reads the order of the human's Box: it is asked which Misery came up, once revealed.
The card's own AFTER, like every look_hand.

open_questions: Do defeated Kakodaemons come back with Woe? Read like Abe Sapien's Agents and Sun Wukong's Clones (revive first, else summon).
Hope: the look is part of the Misery's effect, so it happens when Hope is resolved, before the decision to keep revealing.
